data.name: Browse
data.comment: Button that opens a folder picker.

data.name: ClearSearch
data.comment: Name of the × button in a search box, read out by screen readers.

data.name: ClearSearchTip
data.comment: Tooltip of the × button in a search box.

data.name: Dismiss
data.comment: Hides a message or a finished download from the list.

data.name: Installed
data.comment: Label beside an engine component that's already on disk.

data.name: More
data.comment: Tooltip and screen reader name of the ⋯ button that opens a menu of further actions.

data.name: SectionLocation
data.comment: Section heading: the folder something is installed or created in.

data.name: SectionVersion
data.comment: Section heading: the engine version to pick.

data.name: Working
data.comment: Shown on an engine or item while a download, install or removal is busy with it.

data.name: AboutUnVaultLauncher
data.comment: Tooltip of the version number in the header, which opens the About window.

data.name: Engines
data.comment: Tab with the installed Unreal Engine versions.

data.name: EnginesSignInBanner
data.value: Sign in to see every engine version your account can install. Installed engines can be modified and verified without signing in.

data.name: InstallEngine
data.comment: Tooltip of the + button on the Engines tab.

data.name: Library
data.comment: Tab with the account's Fab library, and its title.

data.name: NoEnginesHint
data.value: Click + to pick a version and only the components you need.

data.name: UnrealEngine
data.comment: Title of the Engines tab. The engine's name; most languages keep it as it is.

data.name: UpdateAvailable
data.comment: Shown beside the version number when a newer release of UnVault Launcher is out.

data.name: InstallEllipsis
data.comment: Reinstalls an engine whose files are gone; opens the install window.

data.name: Launch
data.comment: Starts the Unreal Editor.

data.name: Options
data.comment: Opens the window for changing an installed engine's components.

data.name: ReadingBuildManifest
data.value: Reading the build manifest… (the first time for a version takes a few seconds)

data.name: SectionContent
data.comment: Section heading: optional content such as Starter Content and templates.

data.name: SectionDebugging
data.comment: Section heading: debug symbols.

data.name: DownloadedOnly
data.comment: Filter: show only items in the Vault Cache.

data.name: LibrarySignInBanner
data.value: Showing what's already in your Vault Cache. Sign in to see your whole library and download more.

data.name: ChooseProjectFile
data.comment: Opens a file picker for an Unreal project file; .uproject is the file type and stays as it is.

data.name: SignInCodeWarning
data.value: Epic warns not to share this code with third parties. UnVault Launcher runs on your PC and sends it only to Epic.

data.name: SignInStep1
data.value: 1. Open Epic's sign-in page and sign in. If you're already signed in there, it skips straight to step 2.

data.name: SignInStep2
data.value: 2. The page then shows a short text containing "authorizationCode". Copy all of it and paste it here:
data.comment: authorizationCode is text on Epic's page and stays as it is.

data.name: SignInToEpicGames
data.comment: Title of the sign-in window.

data.name: CheckForUpdatesHint
data.value: Ask GitHub for new releases of UnVault Launcher.

data.name: Default
data.comment: Label beside the project folder new projects are created in.

data.name: ParallelDownloadsHint
data.value: More can be faster on fast connections; fewer is gentler on slow ones.

data.name: RemoveFolder
data.comment: Screen reader name of the button that takes a folder off the list of project folders.

data.name: AboutDescription
data.value: A streamlined and lightweight launcher for installing and managing Unreal Engine and Fab assets and plugins.

data.name: CheckAgain
data.comment: Asks GitHub again whether a newer release is out.

data.name: DataFolderTip
data.comment: What the data folder holds. crash.log is a file name and stays as it is.

data.name: Disclaimer
data.value: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Epic Games. Unreal Engine, Epic Games and Fab are trademarks of Epic Games, Inc.

data.name: Download
data.comment: Opens the page of the newer release.

data.name: Releases
data.comment: Link to the list of UnVault Launcher releases on GitHub.
